cause_of_slow_cleanup.shared_repository_lock: Git publication, checkout creation and removal serialize across pods
cause_of_slow_cleanup.publication_failure: w3-a2 CalledProcessError during review-branch push; stderr was not preserved; push succeeded when retried

search_interruption.evidence: guard and supervisor processes absent on all four search pods, no traceback; cgroup OOM counters checked were zero
search_interruption.recovery: verified process absence and free pod locks; recorded bounded recovery holds; launched new managed run IDs on the same four pods; reuse durable beam state and candidate cache
search_interruption.recovery_outcome: All four replacement guards, supervisors and search processes disappeared again after verified startup and GPU work. Cause remains undetermined. Failure receipts and queue interruption history saved; affected pods retired to stop idle charges.

cleanup_recovery.worktree: removed after verifying its full HEAD is an ancestor of main

repair.reproduction: Injected ENOSPC during supervisor state write reproduces worker termination plus inability to write failure state. Local failure receipt test passes. Historical cause remains unconfirmed.
changes: Independent watchdog detects verified supervisor disappearance and enforces a bounded loss timeout
Lost-supervisor phase blocks takeover until orphan processes are checked
Local-disk emergency receipts preserve safe diagnostics when shared volume writes fail
Safe Git error classification distinguishes full storage, authentication, conflicts, and network failures
repair.resumption: One initial worker, then parallelize four remaining readout chains after health verification. Reuse checkpoint and beam state; BF16 unchanged.
